products.name: Lunar's Lullaby
products.description: A soft nighttime treasure strung on black cord, where blue and white beads hum a quiet lullaby beneath a pink star and flower.
products.lore: Lunar's Lullaby was made for the hour when the lamps go out and the world settles into hush. The blue beads carry the colour of late evening, the solid white beads hold a little of the moon's own light, and the pink star and flower charms drift among them like small dreams refusing to fade. It is a gentle companion for restless nights — a quiet song, tied in cord, for anyone who needs help drifting off.
materials: Pink star and flower vinyl charms
Finished length: 28 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Celestial Flight
products.description: A lilac-threaded bracelet for wings and wonders, with black and purple beads beneath a butterfly, a star and a moon.
products.lore: Celestial Flight was made for the moment a butterfly first opens its wings — that small, trembling courage before takeoff. Lilac cord carries the colour of twilight, while black and purple beads gather the depth of the evening sky. A butterfly, a star and a moon travel together along the strand, as if the little flyer chose the night for its very first journey. A treasure for anyone learning that new beginnings can take flight even after dark.
materials: Finished length: 32 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Moonlight Magic
products.description: A bracelet woven beneath imaginary moonlit skies, where dark crackled stones meet purple sparks of quiet magic.
products.lore: Moonlight Magic was made for the moments when the world feels a little quieter and the night seems to hold its breath. Black crackle beads echo the shadows beneath the moon, while purple beads catch the feeling of distant starlight. Finished with a silver moon charm, this treasure carries a little piece of nighttime wonder wherever it travels.
materials: Finished length: 28 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Wish Upon a Star
products.description: A bright little treasure made for hopeful wishes, with vivid colour and a star to carry them toward the sky.
products.lore: Wish Upon a Star was made for those who still believe that a small wish can become something wonderful. Its hot pink cord brings a flash of playful colour, while the green crackle beads carry a little woodland-like magic. Finished with a star charm, it is a tiny reminder to keep wishing, even when the night feels long.
materials: Finished length: 34 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Ghostly Valentine
products.description: A gentle ghostly bracelet inspired by love that lingers beyond time, made with two bead colours.
products.lore: Some love stories never truly end. Ghostly Valentine carries quiet echoes of affection that remain long after memories begin to fade.
materials: Finished length: 26 cm (may vary with sliding knot)
Finished length: 28 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Whispering Willows
products.description: A woodland-inspired bracelet filled with quiet forest magic.
products.lore: Ancient willow trees are said to whisper forgotten stories to those willing to pause and listen.

products.name: The Seer's Secret
products.description: A mysterious treasure inspired by forgotten prophecies and hidden futures.
products.lore: Hidden behind velvet curtains and crystal visions, The Seer's Secret is inspired by ancient fortune tellers, whispered predictions and the mysteries that time has yet to reveal. This treasure invites its keeper to embrace curiosity, trust their instincts and remember that the future is never truly written in stone.

products.name: The Moonlit Relic
products.description: A quiet keepsake inspired by moonlight, reflection and wonder.
products.lore: Bathed in the gentle glow of the moon, The Moonlit Relic captures the peaceful beauty of the night sky. Inspired by moonlit walks, quiet reflection and timeless wonder, this treasure is a reminder that even in darkness there is beauty waiting to be discovered, and every new night carries the promise of another dawn.

products.name: Stormflower
products.description: A delicate bracelet that celebrates quiet strength and gentle growth after the storm.
products.lore: Stormflower is born from weathered petals and soft resilience, a small talisman for the moments when beauty rises from the rain.

products.name: When the Stars Listen
products.description: A calm bracelet inspired by wishes whispered into the quiet of a starry night.
products.lore: When the Stars Listen was made for those who pause and speak softly to the sky, carrying hope on every bead.

products.name: Beyond the Veil
products.description: A mysterious bracelet that hints at hidden paths and the quiet magic beyond sight.
products.lore: Beyond the Veil is a gentle reminder that not everything must be understood at once; some discoveries are meant to be revealed slowly.

products.name: Forged in Flames
products.description: A bold bracelet built from ember-bright energy and steady strength.
products.lore: Forged in Flames captures the courage of new beginnings, combining heat and heart in a single handmade treasure.

products.name: Wings After Winter
products.description: A soothing bracelet that evokes first flights and gentle renewal after cold days.
products.lore: Wings After Winter is made for the hopeful return of warmth, with soft beads that whisper of new beginnings.

products.name: Dusk Before Dawn
products.description: A deep bracelet inspired by the hush between night and the first light of morning.
products.lore: Dusk Before Dawn carries the quiet promise that even the darkest hour is followed by a new beginning.

products.name: Ashes of Hope
products.description: A hopeful bracelet that holds the quiet glow of new possibilities after loss.
products.lore: Ashes of Hope is a subtle reminder that even when embers fade, a gentle spark can still light the way forward.

products.name: Lost in Moonlight
products.description: A lost moon, caught gently in a thread of blue.
products.lore: Something about a moon that became lost after wandering too far from the night sky — eventually finding its way onto a little thread of blue and refusing to leave.
materials: Originally made using 32 cm of cord.

products.name: Unsung Melody
products.description: A forgotten melody given new life as something unexpected.
products.lore: There was once a song that nobody remembered. Its record was left behind, its melody slowly fading into silence. Then, somewhere between the grooves, a little flower appeared. Perhaps the song wasn't finished after all.
materials: Originally made using 32–33 cm of cord. As each bracelet is handmade and finished with an adjustable sliding knot, the finished size may vary.

products.name: Mushroom Meadow
products.description: A little piece of enchanted forest floor, inspired by mossy clearings and the small wonders hiding beneath the ferns.
products.lore: They say that if you wander far enough off the woodland path, past the brambles and beneath the old trees, you may stumble upon a clearing where mushrooms gather like tiny red-capped villagers. Nobody tends this meadow. Nobody planted it. It simply appears each autumn, quietly beautiful, as if the forest itself decided to keep one small secret just for those who pause and look closely. Mushroom Meadow carries that feeling — the moment of stopping mid-step because something unexpected caught your eye among the leaves.
materials: Finished length: 28 cm (may vary with sliding knot)

products.name: Starlit Spores
products.description: A woodland-night treasure of medium purple and peachy-pink beads beneath a pink star and a green mushroom.
products.lore: They say that deep in the oldest part of the forest grow mushrooms that drink starlight instead of rain. On clear nights their spores lift from the caps and drift upward, and the brightest never fall back down — they join the sky and become stars. Wanderers who have stood in that clearing swear the ground glows faintly, as if the woods were keeping a handful of heavens for themselves. Starlit Spores carries a little of that clearing with it: the feeling of standing somewhere quiet at midnight, looking up, and realising the stars may have grown from the earth all along.

products.name: Poison
products.description: A dangerously sweet treasure of pink and white beads with a melting red heart at its centre.
products.lore: In an apothecary at the edge of town sat a small heart-shaped bottle labelled, in careful handwriting, Poison. Those who peeked inside expected something dark and dangerous, yet the liquid within was soft rose-pink and smelled faintly of valentines. The apothecary never explained. Some say it was brewed for someone who was never told they were loved; others say it was a remedy for hearts gone quietly numb. The label stayed, because the truth was sweeter and stranger: some feelings are so intense they can only be confessed under a dangerous name. Poison is for the keeper of a heart that loves far too much to play it safe.

products.name: Petal & Potion
products.description: A botanical treasure of green and pink beads beneath a large hollow heart, half pink and half wood-coloured.
products.lore: Tucked behind the allotment wall grows a rose no one planted, and beside it a copper pan left out in the rain. Every dawn, petal-fall drifts from the rose into the pan, where the droplets have gathered overnight — and by morning the water has turned the palest pink. It is said this is no accident of the wind. The rose has been steeping a very slow potion, one petal at a time, though for whom — or for what — the garden has never said. Those who lean over the wall swear the air smells of sugar and sap, and that whoever the potion is finally for will know exactly what to do with it.
materials: Large hollow heart charm (half pink, half wood-coloured)

products.name: Rose & Ritual
products.description: A solemn keepsake of red, pink and black beads, woven with quiet ceremony and no charm to speak for it.
products.lore: Before words, there were rituals: a candle lit the same hour each night, a rose laid where someone used to sit, a circle traced so many times it became a door. Devotion has always kept its own calendar, measured not in days but in repetitions. Some ceremonies mourn, and some insist — patiently, stubbornly — that what is loved is not yet lost. This treasure is woven in that spirit, each bead a small vow set in its place, the strand itself the circle that binds them. Its meaning is left deliberately unspoken, for the oldest rituals belong to whoever performs them.

products.name: Woodlands Wonderland
products.description: A very mushroomy treasure: green and peach-pink beads beneath eight identical mushroom charms.
products.lore: Beyond the bramble gate there is a clearing where the mushrooms hold their own midsummer festival. No invitations are sent — none are needed. When the evening light turns peach and the moss deepens to green, eight of the little villagers step out in perfect unison, each one standing precisely where a mushroom stood the year before, and the year before that. The festival has no name, no music and no visitors, yet it has never once been missed. Some wanderers claim the woods feel warmer that night, as though the whole clearing were smiling. This treasure keeps a little of that festival in its keeping — eight small revelers, mid-celebration, forever.
